messages:
Tessa G: dropped a tiny prototype for scorecard rows in compact mode — trying to keep primary actions visible without pushing content off-screen: https://figma.com/file/scorecard-compact. looking for quick copy + a11y checks. :eyes: Omar V: looks good visually. main thing: in very narrow widths approve/reject become icon-only which is fine, but the icons need accessible names (aria-label) and persistent focus outlines. Leah P: +1. also worried about cognitive load when icons are similar. maybe keep 'Approve' label on the primary CTA until container < 440px, then collapse to icon with aria-label = 'Approve result'. Tessa G: plan: label stays until 440px, then icon-only. we'll include aria-label and tooltip on hover. animation 100ms. Omar V: keyboard flow: ensure tab order is predictable: result title -> primary CTA -> overflow. If label collapses, screen reader should still announce the button name. add a live announce on approval: "Result X approved" for SR users. Leah P: good call. small snippet we often ship with these components: ```html
// on approve -> document.getElementById('sc-live').textContent = 'Result 5 approved.' ``` Tessa G: perfect. copy nit: for the overflow menu item should we use 'Request changes' or 'Ask for revision'? trying to be consistent with existing eval language. Omar V: 'Request changes' matches other workflows. keep it terse. Leah P: accessibility nit: ensure the tooltip is not the only accessible label. Tooltip disappears on keyboard focus; aria-label is primary. Also check contrast for icon fill against dark mode background — need >= 3:1 for icons if no text. ux-bot: Accessibility checklist updated: scorecard-compact -> icon-aria-labels, live-region-on-action, tab-order-defined, tooltip-not-only-label, contrast-checks. See /docs/accessibility/scorecard-compact.md :white_check_mark: Tessa G: thanks! I'll update the prototype and add a small PR with the aria-labels + live region + CSS breakpoints. Follow-ups: @Omar V to add keyboard test matrix; @Leah P to run SR checks on NVDA/VoiceOver. Target: feature-flag rollout next sprint. :rocket:
